description:

Among the many texts connected to the Solomonic grimoire tradition, few are as mysterious and visually striking as the Ars Almadel, also known as The Almadel of Solomon. While many people associate the Lesser Key of Solomon primarily with the Ars Goetia and its catalogue of seventy-two spirits, the Ars Almadel belongs to a different current entirely. It is not primarily concerned with demonic conjuration. It is a work of angelic magic, celestial hierarchy, sacred implements, and visionary contact with spirits associated with the heavens.
The Ars Almadel is traditionally presented as the fourth part of the Lemegeton, or Lesser Key of Solomon. The Lemegeton itself is generally understood as a seventeenth-century compilation of magical material, and its sections include the Ars Goetia, Ars Theurgia-Goetia, Ars Paulina, Ars Almadel, and Ars Notoria. The Ars Almadel specifically concerns spirits said to govern the Four Altitudes and the 360 degrees of the Zodiac, making it one of the more celestial and angelic sections of the Solomonic tradition.

Chinta (Reasoning): Inductive logic or thinking about the connection between things.

title: Meta philosophy | Philosophical Study
description:
Meta philosophy: The Philosophy of Philosophy
Meta philosophy functions as a reflexive discipline that analyzes the fundamental nature, objectives, and methodologies of philosophical inquiry. While the practice of self-reflection is ancient, the term was popularized in the 20th century to distinguish between first-order questions about reality and second-order investigations into the field itself. Modern scholars debate whether philosophy is an analytic "armchair" science, an empirical endeavor aligned with the natural sciences, or a therapeutic tool for resolving linguistic confusion. Key discussions within the field explore the possibility of progress, the validity of using intuition as evidence, and the emerging role of computational tools and artificial intelligence. Contemporary movements like conceptual engineering also shift the focus from merely defining existing terms to actively redesigning language for better social and intellectual utility. Ultimately, the provided sources present a comprehensive map of how thinkers evaluate the boundaries and effectiveness of their own academic craft.
